taskComposer.runSettings.chooseAgentToSe.en: Choose an agent to select its model and effort.
taskComposer.runSettings.chooseAgentToSe.zh-CN: 请选择智能体以选择其模型和推理强度。

taskComposer.runSettings.commandHarnessN.en: This agent runs a command. Its harness does not expose a model or effort setting.
taskComposer.runSettings.commandHarnessN.zh-CN: 此智能体运行命令。其运行框架不提供模型或推理强度设置。

taskComposer.runSettings.customIdsHint.en: Custom IDs: openrouter/provider/model. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
taskComposer.runSettings.customIdsHint.zh-CN: 自定义 ID：openrouter/provider/model。运行开始时会检查提供商访问权限。

taskComposer.runSettings.customModelIdsH.en: Custom model IDs can be pasted here. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
taskComposer.runSettings.customModelIdsH.zh-CN: 可以在此粘贴自定义模型 ID。运行开始时会检查提供商访问权限。

taskComposer.runSettings.gatewayRemoteMo.en: This gateway chooses its model remotely; Paperclip has no per-task model setting for it.
taskComposer.runSettings.gatewayRemoteMo.zh-CN: 此网关远程选择模型；Paperclip 不提供单任务模型设置。

taskComposer.runSettings.httpEndpointSer.en: This agent calls an HTTP endpoint. The destination service chooses its model.
taskComposer.runSettings.httpEndpointSer.zh-CN: 此智能体调用 HTTP 端点。目标服务决定其模型。

taskComposer.runSettings.modelIdFormat.zh-CN: 请使用不含空格的 openrouter/provider/model。

taskComposer.runSettings.modelIdsNoSpace.zh-CN: 模型 ID 不能包含空格。
